map.由物质的量与溶液体积计算物质的量浓度。: Compute molar concentration from the amount of substance and the solution volume.
map.📖 查看「摩尔浓度（c = n / V） 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Molarity (c = n / V) Usage Guide"
map.c = n / V；V 为溶液体积(L)。: c = n / V; V is the solution volume (L).
map.2 mol 溶于 1 L 得 2 mol/L。: 2 mol dissolved in 1 L gives 2 mol/L.
map.标准液配制：称固体定容到 V 得 c，作滴定基准。: Standard solution preparation: weigh the solid, dilute to volume V to obtain c, and use it as a titration standard.
map.滴定计算：由 c 与 V 算参加反应摩尔，联算待测浓度。: Titration calculations: use c and V to find the moles that react, then solve for the unknown concentration.
map.稀释复核：稀释后 c 按 C1V1=C2V2 变。: Dilution check: after dilution c follows C1V1 = C2V2.
map.0.5 mol 溶质定容 250 mL 演练: Walkthrough: 0.5 mol of solute made up to 250 mL
map.输入 n=0.5 mol、V=250 mL，工具输出 c=2.0 mol/L，并: Enter n = 0.5 mol and V = 250 mL, the tool outputs c = 2.0 mol/L and reminds you to dilute to the mark rather than adding solvent up to the volume.
map.定容到 V 不是加到 V？: Dilute to V, not add up to V?
map.是定容至刻度：先溶后加水至线，而非加溶剂到 V。: Yes, dilute to the mark: dissolve first, then add water up to the line, rather than adding solvent up to V.
map.体积随温度变，c 略变；精确实验需恒温。: Volume changes with temperature, so c shifts slightly; precise work needs a constant temperature.
map.和 molality 怎么选？: How do I choose between molarity and molality?
map.配制滴定多用 c，依数性用 b。: Use c when preparing titrations, and b for colligative properties.
